profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software engineer gaining experience with C#, React, and Angular. Strong support professional pursuing a Bachelor of Science - BS focused in Computer Science from Brigham Young University - Idaho.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description: Add new features and fix bugs for the Redlist web application. Work in C# and React.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: Refactored monolith application into micro-services, resulting in better scaling and easier extensibility of our app. Developed new features on an existing application that interfaced with SQL database tables

positions.title: Customer Service Manager
positions.description:
Increased customer satisfaction and maintained positive customer relationships
Resolved customer concerns efficiently to improve overall customer satisfaction
Calmly developed solutions to frustrated customer’s problems

volunteerExperiences.description: Led SWE Chapter at BYU-Idaho. Planned and presided at presidency meetings. Oversaw planning and execution of weekly society meetings and monthly socials.
